caption: The drawing displays three objects arranged inside a lightly outlined oval centered on a plain beige background. In the center is a circular or oval brooch with a black background, surrounded by a thin gold border. On this brooch, there is a painted design of flowers that feature purple petals, white centers, and green leaves. Flanking the central brooch are two matching earrings positioned symmetrically to the left and right. Each earring has a round top portion, also black with a gold border, displaying a small flower with purple petals and a green leaf. Below each round top, a long, teardrop-shaped pendant is attached, with a black background and gold border, depicting a similar flower motif matching the central brooch. The paper shows signs of slight discoloration and some smudging, particularly in the area within the oval, but no other objects or markings are present outside this arrangement.
title: Brooch and Earrings
